scope.title: 1. Scope
scope.text: These General Terms and Conditions govern the contractual relationship between {company} (hereinafter "Provider") and the customer in connection with consulting, planning, installation and maintenance services for security systems.

contract.title: 2. Quotation and Contract
contract.text: All quotations are non-binding. A contract is only concluded upon written order confirmation by the Provider or upon commencement of service delivery. Verbal side agreements require written confirmation.

payment.title: 3. Prices and Payment Terms
payment.text: The prices stated in the order confirmation apply in Swiss Francs (CHF). Prices are exclusive of VAT unless otherwise stated. Invoices are payable within 30 days net from the invoice date. In case of late payment, default interest of 5% p.a. will be charged.

service.title: 4. Service Delivery
service.text: The Provider delivers the agreed services professionally and in accordance with recognized technical standards. Scheduled appointments are binding if designated as such in writing. Delays not attributable to the Provider extend agreed deadlines accordingly.

cooperation.title: 5. Customer Cooperation
cooperation.text: The customer grants the Provider the necessary access to the premises and provides the required infrastructure (electricity, etc.). Delays due to lack of cooperation are at the customer's expense.

warranty.title: 6. Warranty
warranty.text: The statutory warranty provisions under Swiss Code of Obligations apply. Manufacturer warranty conditions apply to installed components. Defects must be reported in writing immediately upon discovery.

liability.title: 7. Liability
liability.text: The Provider is liable for damages caused by intentional or grossly negligent conduct. Liability for slight negligence is excluded to the extent permitted by law. Liability is in any case limited to the order value. No liability is assumed for indirect damages, lost profits or consequential damages.

confidentiality.title: 8. Confidentiality
confidentiality.text: Both parties undertake to keep confidential any information that becomes known in the course of cooperation and not to disclose it to third parties.

jurisdiction.title: 9. Applicable Law and Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.text: Swiss law applies exclusively, excluding conflict of laws provisions and the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. The exclusive place of jurisdiction is {city}, Switzerland.

severability.title: 10. Severability Clause
severability.text: Should individual provisions of these Terms be or become invalid, the validity of the remaining provisions shall not be affected. The invalid provision shall be replaced by a valid one that comes closest to the economic purpose.

data.title: 2. Data Collected
data.intro: We collect the following data when you contact us through the quotation form:
data.technical: Additionally, technical data (e.g., time of access) is collected in anonymized form when visiting the website.

purpose.title: 3. Purpose of Data Processing
purpose.text: The collected data is used exclusively for processing your inquiry and for contacting you. No data is shared with third parties for advertising purposes.

retention.title: 4. Retention Period
retention.text: Inquiries are stored for as long as necessary to process your request and to comply with legal retention obligations (typically 10 years for business documents under Swiss Code of Obligations).

cookies.title: 5. Cookies
cookies.text: This website only uses technically necessary cookies for site operation. No tracking cookies or third-party cookies are used.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.text: You have the right to information, correction and deletion of your personal data. For such requests, please contact the email address provided above.

security.title: 7. Data Security
security.text: We take appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss or misuse. Data transmission is encrypted.

changes.title: 8. Changes
changes.text: We reserve the right to amend this privacy policy as needed. The current version is always available on this page.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.text: The author assumes no responsibility for the correctness, accuracy, timeliness, reliability and completeness of the information on this website. Liability claims against the author for material or immaterial damages arising from access to or use or non-use of the published information are excluded, unless there is demonstrable intentional or grossly negligent fault.

links.title: Liability for Links
links.text: References and links to third-party websites are outside our area of responsibility. Any responsibility for such websites is declined. Access to and use of such websites is at the user's own risk.

copyright.title: Copyright
copyright.text: The copyright and all other rights to content, images, photos or other files on this website belong exclusively to {company} or the specifically named rights holders. Written consent of the copyright holder must be obtained in advance for reproduction of any elements.
